supplier.name: Diversey, Inc.
supplier.address: 1300 Altura Rd., Suite 125, Fort Mill, SC 29708, US

classification: Undiluted product: Serious eye damage, Category 1
1:18 diluted product: Not classified as hazardous under OSHA HazCom 2012

prevention: Avoid contact with eyes, skin, and clothing.
Wash affected areas thoroughly after handling.
Wear protective gloves and eye or face protection.
response: If on skin, wash with plenty of soap and water.
If skin irritation occurs, obtain medical advice or attention.
If in eyes, rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.
Remove contact lenses when present and easy to remove.
Continue rinsing for at least 15 minutes.
Immediately call a Poison Center or physician.
Remove contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

data.other_hazards: HHNOC and PHNOC are stated as not applicable. No hazard or precautionary statements are required for the 1:18 diluted product.

ingredients.name: Benzenesulfonic acid, C10-16-alkyl derivatives, potassium salts

data.eyes: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes; remove contact lenses when present and easy to remove; continue rinsing for at least 15 minutes.
data.skin: Wash with plenty of soap and water and continue rinsing with water for at least 15 minutes. Obtain medical advice if irritation occurs.
data.inhalation: No specific first-aid measures are required.
data.ingestion: Call a Poison Center or physician if the exposed person feels unwell.

suitable_extinguishing_media: The product is not flammable; use an extinguishing agent suitable for the surrounding fire.
specific_hazards: Corrosive material; see SDS sections 8 and 10.
data.firefighter_protection: Wear pressure-demand self-contained breathing apparatus approved by MSHA/NIOSH or equivalent and full protective gear.

personal_precautions: Put on appropriate personal protective equipment described in section 8.
protective_equipment: Appropriate PPE for the exposure conditions.
containment: For large spills, absorb with inert material such as dry sand or earth.
cleanup: Place absorbed material in a chemical-waste container.
Use a water rinse for final cleanup.

safe_handling: For commercial and industrial use only.
Avoid contact with skin, eyes, and clothing.
Treat empty containers and residue with the same handling precautions.
Remove and wash contaminated clothing and footwear before reuse.
storage_conditions: Store in a dry, cool, well-ventilated place.
incompatible_materials: Do not mix with any other product or chemical unless specified in the use directions.

data.engineering_controls: Good general ventilation should be sufficient to control airborne levels.
data.eye_protection: Undiluted product: chemical-splash goggles. Diluted product: no eye PPE required under normal use conditions.
data.hand_protection: Undiluted product: chemical-resistant gloves. Diluted product: no hand PPE required under normal use conditions.
data.skin_body_protection: No personal protective equipment required under normal use conditions.
data.respiratory_protection: No respiratory PPE required under normal use conditions. Use appropriate respiratory protection if aerosols, mists, or vapors are not adequately controlled by ventilation.
hygiene_measures: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice.

data.voc: 0.1% by weight; 0% by weight at use dilution

incompatible_materials: Do not mix with another product or chemical unless specified in the use directions.

symptoms.skin: Pain, which may be delayed, redness, and discomfort.
symptoms.eyes: Pain, burning sensation, redness, watering, blurred vision, or loss of vision.
symptoms.inhalation: Irritation and corrosive effects to the nose, throat, and respiratory tract; coughing and difficulty breathing.

data.acute_toxicity: Estimated acute toxicity values exceed the SDS classification thresholds stated.
